proposed_comments.title: Keep promoted source-key lifetime independent of settings changes
proposed_comments.body:
### Keep promoted source-key lifetime independent of settings changes

**Severity:** `high`

Once an Alone source is promoted, its original key-down has already been injected and must receive exactly one matching release. The current runtime bookkeeping can be cleared or bypassed by a settings reload, editor capture, mapping removal, a numpad identity change, or a blocked key-up injection; those paths can leave a modifier/key logically stuck or leave stale state that swallows the next press. Please retain promoted-key identity independently of the current mapping table (including numpad scan identity), clear pending versus promoted state separately on the hook thread, resolve promoted key-ups before consulting reloaded mappings, and let the physical key-up pass through when the injected release fails. Regression coverage should include reload/removal, editor suspension, numpad Shift/NumLock identity changes, hook teardown, and blocked release injection.
